head_commit.message:
Restore the suite to green: unpin four sessions' tests from a refreshed snapshot

origin/main was red before this merge (publish run 39678819340 failed the unit
test step), because c55b4b0 republished the legacy root fallback and data/latest.json
is now the 2026-10-21T21:27:36Z harvest (75 rows) instead of the 2026-10-18
bootstrap (98 rows). Six tests were pinned to rows that snapshot no longer
contains; each is fixed with the same promise and a replayable input:

- tests/test_day5_e0fd5a32.py and tests/test_day5_f4e34907.py read the archived
  dated harvest research/session-a54996e1/snapshot.json, where the two final-day
  TWC fixtures are still open and priced, instead of the mutable root snapshot
  and staged pages.
- tests/test_session_d6df5beb.py accepts both ranking-order research tiers
  (research_rank_single, research_vrs_single - neither publishes a probability)
  and asserts the inventory verdict's current wording ('no main-event row').
- tests/test_coverage_76712ccc.py requires a pick-only row to publish its own
  primary source (hltv_context.source, or the official Valve standings URL for a
  research_vrs_single row that HLTV never listed) and replays the ex-6666
  regression against the archived 2026-10-18 harvest that still carries 1081521.

Measured: 573 tests OK (main: 553 with 4 failures + 2 errors), audits 9 OK,
integrity 5 OK, verification-c6 12 OK, scripts.validate on data/latest.json and
the staged site passes (655 links, 20 checksums, 176 rows), browser suite green.

Co-authored-by: arena-agent <297053741+arena-agent@users.noreply.github.com>

head_commit.message:
Merge origin/main into arena/bf09aa40-maltaproj4, keeping both sessions' work

Conflicts resolved by union, not by choice:

- scripts/hltv.py: this session's dated-view reads (date_views, DATE_PAGE_LIMIT,
  same_pair_other_start) and main's team-page research (search_teams, team_profile,
  team_pages, fallback_lineups, data/lineup-receipts.json) both stay; research()
  ends by calling team_pages() exactly as main had it.
- data/identities.json: one merged Off Chops = THUNDER dOWNUNDER entry whose basis
  carries both this session's Liquipedia/HLTV evidence and db1f35c5's DFRAG
  evidence with all four corroboration links; db1f35c5's Zetta = Alianza Lima
  Esports entry preserved. 20 aliases, no duplicate canonical.
- scripts/build.py methodology prose: main's new 'team pages when HLTV has no
  fixture identity' tier plus this session's rename rule, dated-view wording
  (own UTC day then the two neighbouring HLTV days, max six reads) and the
  rename-powered model line.
- .github/workflows/pages.yml: main's sorted branch list plus arena/bf09aa40-maltaproj4.
- COORDINATION.md: both prepend blocks kept; this session's entry corrected -
  main already resolves fixture 1081597 to a research pick, so 'stays unpicked'
  described only this branch's 21:18Z harvest.
- research/quotes-76712ccc/UNPRICED-FIXTURE-LINES.*: main's committed bytes kept
  (regenerating would add 2 failures to the 6 that already exist on main);
  staleness logged as a cross-session request for 76712ccc.

Measured: 573 tests, the same 6 failures as a clean worktree at origin/main
(row-pinning tests invalidated by main's 21:27:36Z data/latest.json refresh);
audits 9, integrity 5, verification-c6 12 all OK; build 75 sourced rows, 11 with
percentages, 0 unresolved; validator 655 links/assets, 20 checksums, 176 rows.
